selection: at most two correct candidates with complete26+17 screens, ordered by Octane core16/13suite point ratio; inspect and bound-check all >10% coarse regressions. Selection is exploratory, not an engine ranking.
balance: per case each condition appears in each of three positions exactly once; fixed seed20261105 shuffles cases and rotations
statistics: 10000 shared complete-round paired resamples, seed20261105, recompute per-case medians and hierarchical GM; percentile95, exploratory unadjusted
primary_for_possible_formal: Octane core16/13suite, with expanded17/14suite separately reported; SunSpider all26 is supporting/robustness evidence, not a requirement to invent a universal win
formal_gate_clarification: Correctness and mechanism evidence required. Primary recheck direction must be supported versus BOTH frozen A and actual M parent (point<1, exploratory upper95<1, at least two of three rounds<1); major regressions must be checked and explained/disclosed. Otherwise no final30, no new V8 campaign.
small_effects: No minimum20% or mandatory3%; a crossing interval is inconclusive, not proof of zero benefit
random_two_cases: No deletion or changed random input in all26. If a final selection depends on the two unseeded cases, separately named seeded sensitivity is required; no mixing of modes.
search_stop: Four complete designs planned, alternatives rejected for overlap/safety budget; no parameter-enumeration candidates added to force six or a favorable result. At most two rechecks, then decision.
